_comment: Phase 3 example: ONE behaviour end-to-end - daily reward claiming.

target._comment: Server URL lives here, not in source, so the engine carries no hardcoded host. url_contains is what find_page_target matches.

timing._comment: Ranges, not fixed values. Fixed delays are the most machine-like signal there is.
timing._loading_note: Cold start measured at 25-30s; a sub-app stalled at 3% indefinitely.

templates._comment: Thresholds are MEASURED peaks minus a 0.07 margin, calibrated against ref/raw/ frames via engine/calibrate.py. Live PNG captures should score at or above these, since the references are lossy JPEG.

claim_daily._flag: Peak 0.808 is well below its peers (median 0.973) - the button likely has an animated gloss. RE-MEASURE against a live capture before trusting this threshold.

close_popup_x_large._note: re-cut from a reference frame and upscaled x2.204. The previous crop was flat ~0.547 at every scale and never fired, which made the calendar popup unclassifiable. Also matches the lucky-spin X at 0.830.

lobby_rail_fortune._note: POSITIVE lobby anchor. The village labels are semi-transparent over animated art and unusable; this rail icon is opaque and absent in combat (0.356). Reads ~0.69 with a popup open, since the rail is still on screen behind the modal - popup states are checked first.

close_popup_back_arrow._note: re-cut and upscaled x2.204 from a reference frame; the original crop was flat ~0.55 at every scale and never fired.

states._comment: Declarative FSM. No state logic in engine code.

daily_reward_popup._comment: Claim is DISABLED by default. Claiming is irreversible and once-per-day.

verify._comment: Confirm via colour mask, not template. The two claimed ticks measured 3318 and 3323 px - counting green blobs is sturdier than matching a tick.

drain_login_popups._comment: Login queues FOUR popups: Daily Reward -> Calendar -> Wishing Tree -> Lucky Spin. Dismiss controls are NOT uniform, hence a set.

lobby._comment: Anchor on the opaque bottom-bar icons and the logo. Never on the village text labels - they are semi-transparent over animated art.

safety._dry_run_note: Detect and log only, never click. Keep true until thresholds are calibrated.
safety._guard_note: These consume a daily resource. Never auto-click without an explicit opt-in.

logging._comment: Log every template's OBSERVED confidence each cycle, including misses - that number is what you tune against.
logging._redact_note: The SWF request URL carries a live session token. Never log URLs or console output.

geometry._comment: Pin with Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride. NEVER resize the ruffle-player element via CSS - that desyncs click->stage mapping inside the SWF. WHY 1720x720: Ruffle scales the stage by min(vw/960, vh/720) - the stage is 960x720, confirmed from the game's own SWF (ref/swf_assets/). Pinning HEIGHT to exactly 720 makes height the limiting factor, so scale stays exactly 1.0 and ALL extra width becomes free page margin. Measured: at 1720x720 the game canvas occupies CSS x 380..1340, leaving 380px of decorative page background on each side - enough for the control panel with ZERO occlusion of game pixels. Template confidence also improved (lobby_rail_fortune 0.958 -> 1.000). An earlier attempt widened to 1340x880 and rescaled the game; the culprit was the HEIGHT (880/720 = 1.222), not the width.
geometry._why_pinned: Text templates lose ~0.4 confidence at 8% scale error (loading_text 0.489). matchTemplate is not scale-invariant.
geometry._canonical: 960x839 @ dsf2 -> canvas 1920x1678 native, which is the geometry the templates were cut at, so they match at scale ~1.0. Earlier this said 1728x851, contradicting CLAUDE.md and putting the true peak (~0.55) outside the locked scale band - every template scored wrong.
geometry._viewport_alt: 960x839 also gives scale 1.0 (width-limited) but leaves no side margin, so the panel can only be drawn OVER the game.

hp_bar_mask_bgr._comment: Bright red only. A looser range (R>=90) matches the dark EMPTY track and reports every bar as 100% full.

combat._comment: Derived from two full mission runs. See CLAUDE.md for the measurements.

turn_gate._why: Marker position and fixed timing both fail; command-bar presence does not.

combat._priority_why: The Victory panel draws OVER the command bar; presence alone is ambiguous.

skill_slots._comment: Slots are typed and costs vary. Verify each before enabling.

S4._note: pale palette - reads low saturation while READY; needs baseline compare

targeting._unresolved: skill targeting produced no damage on both plate and sprite in the boss fight; investigate
targeting._mechanism: Game resolves targets by character ID internally; the UI maps a click to an ID. Reference bots expose Auto vs ID selection for this reason.

watchdog._why: Enemies regenerate; observed 43.0 -> 47.2 with attacks landing.

cooldowns._comment: Cooldowns are integer ROUNDS (client decrements once per round). Track by bookkeeping via engine/combat.CooldownTracker; do NOT rely on icon saturation.
cooldowns._how_to_fill: Use a slot, count rounds until it works again, record here.

status_effects._comment: The (n) suffix is DURATION IN ROUNDS, not a stack count.
